LESSON: CONNECTED TEXT AND FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Connected text and fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

Teach

• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Connected text and fluency.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.

• One clear model for Connected text and fluency

1. Write 5 sentences.
